notes: No prior precedent (fresh Rule 2 sweep). robots.txt checked first: generic 'User-agent: *' disallows only (/search, /checkout, /cart, /customer, /login, /api, /admin, filter query params) — no Claude-specific disallow, not a block case. Site is a live, active Next.js storefront (fresh 2026 promotions/stock) — Rule 3 retired-catalogue check: not applicable, fully operational. ACCESS ROUTE: category listing pages (/en/category/...) are 100% client-side-rendered SPA (initial HTML is pure loading-skeleton markup — 'shimmergray'/'shimmerlight' placeholders — for every listing/related-products section, even under Googlebot UA; no product data or count ever present in raw HTML/JSON-in-script). Found no accessible /api/ or /graphql route on the frontend origin itself (those paths just hit the Next.js catch-all page and 404). Located the real headless backend via reverse-engineering the route-specific JS chunk (app/[locale]/category/[category]/[...subCategory]/page-*.js -> chunk 5199-*.js): a separate Laravel API host, api.chattelsandmore.com, with endpoint GET /api/category-products/{categoryId}/{categorySlug}?locale=en&per_page=N&page=M returning {data:{products:[...],meta:{current_page,last_page,per_page,total}}}. Category IDs were recovered from the SSR-embedded homepage mega-menu JSON (self.__next_f flight payload, key 'headerMainMenu') and, for third-level nodes, from the same flight payload on the parent category's own page. VERIFICATION (Rule 1): every leaf qty below is api.chattelsandmore.com meta.total, and it matches the SSR homepage mega-menu 'count' field exactly for all 7 in-scope nodes (independent cross-check, two different code paths agree). Additionally exhaustion-checked Mirrors at per_page=250: 60 unique product IDs returned, all status=1 (enabled) — meta.total is not variant/disabled-inflated, unlike Shopify-style totals seen elsewhere on this project. DUPLICATE/BRAND-FACET FOUND: the site also exposes a full parallel 'Kare' (KARE Design) brand mini-catalogue at /en/kare/category/... with its own mega-menu counts (e.g. Kare Mirrors=49, Kare Decorative Accessories=231, Kare Floor Lamps=14) — every Kare count is a strict subset of the corresponding main-catalogue count, confirming Kare is a brand FILTER over the same product IDs, not additional inventory; excluded per facet/re-cut rule, not emitted as separate rows. ROLLUP DECISION: 'Decorative Accessories' (24) and 'Dinnerware' (27) both have named sub-facet children in the sitemap, but their child counts do not partition the parent cleanly — Decorative Accessories children (Wall Clocks 3 + Vases 116 + Figurines & Sculptures 71 + Candles & Candleholders 23 + Games 3 = 216) sum to well under the parent total (353, ~137 items uncategorized into any named sub-facet); Dinnerware children (Cups & Mugs 19 + Glassware 186 + Plates & Bowls 83 + Serveware 25 + Dinnerware Sets 1 + Flatware 8 + Crystalware 48 = 370) sum to MORE than the parent total (327, i.e. overlapping cross-listings). Per 'mixed roll-ups: drop, don't pad' and to avoid under/over-counting, both are emitted as single verified-total leaves at the parent level rather than subdivided into their non-partitioning sub-facets. Decorative Accessories includes wall clocks, vases, figurines/sculptures, candles & candleholders, and decorative games (backgammon/chess-style decor sets, titled 'Decorative Games for Stylish Entertainment') — could not title-filter out any scented candles within the Candles & Candleholders slice (23 of 353 items) since individual product listings are unreachable without JS; flagged as a minor known caveat, not large enough to materially move the total. Dinnerware filed under Kitchen & Dining per brief and includes glassware/crystalware (explicitly in-scope). EXCLUDED (checked, out of scope): Carpets & Rugs, Cushions, Faux Trees & Plants, Plaids (throws), Fragrances, Table Linen, Bedding/Pillows/Mattress, all furniture (Sofas, Armchairs, TV Stands, Coffee/Side Tables, Stools & Ottomans, Storage & Home Office, Dining Tables, Dining Chairs, Consoles & Sideboards, Beds, Nightstands, Dressers), and Bathroom (only Towels + Bath Robes under this node, both textile, no decorative/mirror/lighting items filed separately there). No lighting subcategories beyond Floor/Ceiling/Table Lamps exist in the sitemap (no pendants/chandeliers/wall-lights as distinct nodes — genuinely a small boutique lighting range). Rule 0 gains: none beyond standard (no room-named lighting branches to rescue; Mirrors/Wall Art/Decorative Accessories/Dinnerware are flat, non-room-organized catalogues).
